pages.text: One farm feeds a web of foods and drinks. Grow grain, malt it, brew it, then distil it and age it in a cask. Every step can be done well or badly, and each drink keeps a record of it in its $(l:basics/stars)stars$(/l).

Hover over any of our items: it says what it is and what to do next. The $(l:basics/hydrometer)Hydrometer$(/l), Jade or The One Probe shows what a station is doing.$(br2)These chapters follow the advancements, from a wild crop to a cellar of aged spirits.

pages.name: Seed to Cellar
pages.text: Barley in the field, a kettle over a fire, a cask to age it in: the whole story.
